selectedFunctions.label: Ease deposit wNXM into stNXM
warnings: Static deployment/source/ABI metadata only: no API-key grant, persistent runtime attestation, financial safety, backing, liquidity, successful execution or complete funded workflow assurance. Existing authorization, policy, pause and canonical-calldata controls remain mandatory. Zero native value required.

Ease owns this stNXM liquid-underwriting vault, its receipt accounting and delayed withdrawals; this is not a curator label attached to an admitted Nexus vault. Nexus staking pools, wNXM, Uniswap positions, Morpho market, external valuation and owner allocations remain material dependencies, not independently runtime-attested here. Insurance claims and investment losses can reduce receipt value.

Amounts are raw wNXM/stNXM units (18 decimals). Deposit exact assets floors shares; mint exact shares rounds assets up. Caller must already hold wNXM and give ERC20 allowance separately; neither approvals nor signatures are admitted. The update modifier wraps existing NXM and accounts owner-configured admin fees.

Withdraw and redeem are REQUESTS, not immediate payment. They move shares from msg.sender to the vault; implementation ignores receiver and owner in _withdraw, so only caller-owned shares fund the request even if inherited max checks use owner. Use caller for owner and receiver. Withdraw rounds requested shares up, redeem floors quoted assets. Reserve availability includes all pending shares; maxWithdraw/maxRedeem are not complete availability guarantees.

One request per caller: additional requests aggregate uint104 shares and reset the clock. withdrawFinalize(_user) can be called by anyone but pays only the recorded _user, never the caller or a supplied recipient. Current observed withdrawDelay=172800 seconds. Finalize during the one-day post-delay window burns escrowed shares and transfers contemporaneously valued wNXM; after that window it restores shares instead of paying assets. Losses or changing valuation affect proceeds.

Custom OwnedUpgradeabilityProxy implementation() currently resolves 0xaaf02d93686107ce2793b90f33c86bda2ea9e5f3; not EIP1967 (its standard implementation slot is zero). Proxy and implementation Etherscan Exact Match; that is source binding, not financial safety. Point-in-time paused=false. Owner pause/fees/allocation/upgrades remain mutable; deposits do not apply notPaused, while withdrawal requests and finalization do.
